Overview
Curriculum
Unlock your potential in AI with this comprehensive course from IBM SkillsBuild.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) is among the hottest technologies reshaping the future of work! Here's your opportunity to build your knowledge, understand what AI can mean for your future, and visualize yourself in an AI-driven career. You'll begin by exploring AI's history, then discover how it can change the world around you. As you progress, you will delve into how AI understands language, interprets images, and learns using neural networks modeled after the human brain.
